tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yang gter phag dkar gsang chen thugs tig gi phrin las kyi byang bu bde chen bcud 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

kun khyab bde stong 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings/ /mtshan dpe'i gar bsgyur rdo rje btsun mo dang*/ /dbyer med bla ma mchog la gus btud nas/ /de sgrub byed pa'i phrin las 'dir gsal bya/ /de la dbang gis rgyud smin cing dam tshig dag pa'i rnal 'byor pas dur khrod la sogs pa dben zhing zil che ba'i gnas su/ sgrub pa'i khang pa byi dor bya zhing bdud rtsi lnga'i chus chag chag gdab/ dbang dang sgrub mchod sogs kyi tshe maṇ+ḍal gyi gzhir mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor ji ltar rigs pa 'du byas pa'i khar mañdzi'i steng du thod pa mtshan ldan nang sgrub pa'i dpal gtor brjid dang ldan pa bris sku dang sngags byang brgyan cing dar gdugs kyis spras pa dang*/ rgyun du gtor ma tsam la brten pas kyang rung ste de'i mdun du sman gtor rak+ta tshogs kyi 'khor lo mar me brgya rtsa sogs mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor pa dang sngon gtor dkar bgegs kyang bsham/ rang nyid skra grol zhing kha nub tu phyogs pas bde ba'i stan la 'khod/ tshig bdun dang brgyud 'debs sngon tu 'gro bas/ cho ga dngos la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las dang po la bdun las thog mar gzhi bdag la gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ rang nyid skad cig gis rta mchog he ru ka khro gtum bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar bar gyur par bsams la/ gtor ma rta sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa brlab/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drang*/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a ka ro mu khaṃ sogs lan gsum gyis bsngo/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di/

/bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshaḥ sa rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ dkar gtor gtsang sar bskyal/ gnyis pa bgegs gtor ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang : oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa brlab: oṃ sarba bhū ta ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sa mgron dgug: oṃ sarba bigh+nān ba liṃ ta khā hi sa bsngos la bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐: sku dang ye shes dkyil 'khor 'dir: tha mal snang zhen gdon bgegs kun: rig rtsal gnyug ma'i bka' byung gis: rang bzhin 'od gsal dbyings su dengs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gsum pa rgyud sbyang ba ni/ lhag pa'i lha dang bla ma dbyer med par shes pa la mos 'dun drag po rtse gcig pas tshogs shing mkha' khyab tu sad pa'i spyan sngar/ na mo: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun: dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar: phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang : yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: dngos bshams yid las byung ba yi: kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod: tshe rabs thog med sdig ltung dang : dam tshig nyams chags snying nas bshags: dge ba kun la yi rangs shing : chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang : mya ngan mi 'dar bzhugs gsol 'debs: gzhan don rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems: dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi: sgo gsum lha sngags ye shes las: mi 'da' rdo rje'i sdom pa gzung : bsod nams 'di dang gzhan rnams kun: ma lus blo yis yongs bsdoms nas: chos kyi dbyings su bsngos pa'i mthus: 'gro kun sangs rgyas myur thob shog: lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥtshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par bsam: bzhi pa rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje snyems ma gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba:

dar dang rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa: zhabs rdo rje dang pad+ma'i skyil mo krung gis mnyam par sbyor ba'i yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi thugs ka dang sbyor mtshams nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs: hūm̐ la thim pas byin rlabs dang gzi brjid 'od du 'bar bar bsam: oṃ: bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje sems: skyabs gnas kun 'dus bdag la dgongs: bdag gi tshe rabs thog med nas: bsags pa'i sdig ltung nyams chags kun: mi 'chab mi sbed snying nas bshags: slan chad sdom par dam bca' na: ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis: dag cing tshangs par stsal du gsol: zhes gsol ba btab pas thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung : rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs: lus kyi nang gang : nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag par bsams la/ yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ sogs bshags sdom mthar rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gsang ba gsum dang dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur par bsam la ci gnas su bzhag /lnga pa khyad par byin rlabs gnad 'bebs bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang mdun nam mkha' 'od lnga'i klong : seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang : mthing gsal rdor dril yum dang 'khril: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras: zhabs zung rdo rje'i skyil krung gis: ye shes 'od lnga'i klong na bzhugs: sku ni dge 'dun gsung dam chos: thugs ni gdod nas rdzogs sangs rgyas: phung khams skye mched yi dam lha: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs: skyabs kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur: ces gsal btab la tshogs bsag pa'i slad du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyi ltar snod bcud bkod pa rdzogs: nang du lus dang longs spyod rgyan: gsang ba byang sems maṇ+ḍa la: 'bul lo byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: rat+na maṇ+ḍal pū dza ho: mos gus drag pos gsol ba gdab pa ni: rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang : skyabs gnas kun 'dus bdag nyid la: snying nas gus pas gsol ba 'debs: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: zhes brgya stong sogs dang : oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru badz+ra dha ra dzñā na sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes ci nus bzlas mthar dbang blang ba ni: bla ma yab yum sbyor mtshams nas: ye shes bdud rtsi'i char rgyun babs: rang gi gnas bzhi'i 'khor lo gang : sgrib bzhi dag cing dbang bzhi thob: dga' bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skyes: sku bzhi thob pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs: mthar ni rang thim gnyis med gyur: ces thugs yid bsres te rig pa ma bcos spro bsdu bral ba'i ngang bskyangs te mnyam par bzhag /'di rnams rtags thon par nyams su blang ngo : drug pa bgegs bskrad cing mtshams bsrung ba ni/ rang skad cig gis dpal he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ gi sgras khro bo'i sprin rab 'byams su spros te rnal 'byor zab mo bsgom pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs tshogs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad par bsams la hūm̐ bzhi pa'i sngags brjod: khro tshogs rnams slar 'dus te rang la thim pa 'od du zhu ba las srung ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa yangs shing rgya che ba go skabs med pas gtams pa'i dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba: steng 'og dang phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs la sprul pa'i khro bo bcu rngams brjid 'bar ba de'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i rwa ba: me'i gur: mda'i drwa ba rnams kyis bskor ba bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang gzhom zhing gzhig par mi nus pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo gsal zhing brtan par bsams la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐:

tsakra badz+ra sā ra a na la dz+wa la sam̐ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: bdun pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes brjod pas bgegs bsang zhing stong par sbyang : stong pa'i ngang las gnas yul dur khrod zhing gi bkod pa 'byams klas pa'i dbus su: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas stong pa'i rang bzhin: bde ba'i rnam pa: ye shes kyi rol mo mkha' khyab tu 'char bar bsams la: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+yā shap+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ pañtsa kā ma gu na āḥhūm̐: oṃ bod+dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha hūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ tu āḥhūm̐: ma hā su kha dzñā na badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ: gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdag mdun gnyis las dang po la drug las thog mar dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba 'od du zhu ba las 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du chos kyi 'byung gnas yangs shing rgya che ba'i phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i lte bar sna tshogs pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du rang sems gnyug ma mi shigs pa'i thig le hrīḥyig dkar gsal yongs su gyur pa las skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar rab tu dkar zhing dwangs ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa: zhi zhing 'dzum la cung zad khro bo'i nyams dang bcas rjes su chags pa'i gzi byin ches cher 'bar ba: rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal nag po ngur sgra sgrogs pas sa gsum g.yo ba: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba'i myu gu bzhi gtsigs pa: phyag g.yas pas 'khor los mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar bas gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog gcod cing : g.yon thod pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba thugs kar bsnams pas bde chen ye shes kyi rgyun 'bebs pa: gru mo g.yon du yab he ru ka sbas pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje'i kha ṭām̐ ga'i rnam par 'chang bas bde stong gnyis su med pa:

dbu skra thor cog spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser 'khor los mtshan cing lhag ma sil bur grol bas sku sked yan chad khebs pa: nu 'bur mkhregs shing gsang ba'i pad+mo rgyas pa: thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can: rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang dar dpyangs kyis brgyan pa: zhabs g.yas pa skums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhugs pa'i snying ga'i dbus su rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems pa mtshon gang ba: de'i thugs kar nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor hrīḥ dkar pos mtshan pa la sems gtad pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa skyes pa'i rkyen gyis de las 'od zer 'phros: lus kyi nang thams cad mun khung du sgron me btegs pa ltar gsal bar byas: de'i rkyen gyis skad cig gis snying ga'i nang skor gyi rtsa 'dab bzhi la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi: phyi skor brgyad la sgo mtshams ma brgyad: spyi bo la sogs pa'i rtsa mdud rnams su yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rnal 'byor ma rnams dang : gzhan yang rtsa khams thams cad dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba gdod nas lhun grub tu bzhugs pa rnams lam gyis gsal bar gyur/ lha rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po: mgrin par āḥdamar po: thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po: lte bar hoḥser po rnams kyis mtshan pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i bdag nyid du bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3ham̐: zhes nga rgyal gzung*/ gnyis pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs pa ni/ mig gyen du blta zhing 'bar ba'i rgya dang bcas phaiṃ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo mkha' khyab tu sad par bsams la/ oṃ: stong pa shin tu yod med las: ye shes sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir:

byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra bhā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi: zhes pas spyan drang : badz+ra dzñā na sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gsum pa dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ slar yang phaiṃ zhes pas dbang lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa rnams kyis byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi'i sprin chen pos mngon par dbang bskur bas tha mal snang zhen gyi dri ma dag: bde ba mchog gi ye shes mngon du byas: chu lhag ma spyi bor brtan pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa ma hā su kha su ra s+t+waṃ a haṃ: bzhi pa mchod pa ni/ thugs ka nas sprul pa'i phyi nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mngon par mchod cing bstod pas bde chen ye shes kyi gzi byin spel bar bsams la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga puṣ+paṃ: dhū paṃ: dī paṃ: gan+dhaṃ: nai bid+yaṃ: shap+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa sa ma ya ho: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: rak+ta bi pa ho: i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa bhūñdza ho: lnga pa bstod pa ni/ oṃḥ bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo ni: zla ba ltar dkar rjes chags nyams: ye shes gzi byin cher 'bar ba: khams gsum dbang phyug ma la bstod: de nas thog mar phyi dbyibs kyi lha sku dang : rim par nang rtsa khams lhar gsal ba la sems rtse gcig tu gzung : gsal snang skyes pa na rang bzhin gnyug ma'i ye shes dang bsres nas nga rgyal brtan: phyi nang gi rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa'i lha rnams sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i ye shes mngon par byang chub pa'i chos so bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag cing : mngon par byang chub pa'i chos thams cad kyang lha so bdun gyi rnam par shar ba dang : ye shes kyi rang rtsal mkha' khyab tu 'phro ba'i bdag nyid can du shes par byas la dag pa rab 'byams kyi rtsal sbyang ba ste/ de ni sku bskyed rim bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya des skyo na/

drug pa gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi sgrub thabs ni/ ye shes sems ma'i thugs kar nyi zla'i gwa 'u kha sbyor gyi lte bar hrīḥdakar po mar me ltar 'bar ba'i mthar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yon skor du 'khod par mos la: yid mig rlung gsum nang du gtad de sems rtse gcig tu 'dzin bzhin pas: oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: zhes 'bum phrag bzhi bzla ba ni bsnyen pa'o: thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung : zhal nas thon: yab he ru ka'i ngo bo kha ṭ+wām̐ ga'i rtse mo nas zhugs: bde ba chen po'i gzi byin 'bar: rtsa ba nas brgyud gsang ba'i pad+mo nas gyen du byung : de ltar bar ma chad par 'khor bas mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes brtan par bsams la: oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye ma hā su kha dzñā na hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā:

'bum phrag gnyis bzla ba ni sgrub pa'o: slar yang sngags phreng las bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi 'od zer rab tu 'bar bas 'khor 'das kyi khams thams cad khyab cing g.yos: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi byin rlabs bsdus te bdag la thim: khams gsum gyi 'gro kun sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa bsregs shing sbyangs: dwangs ma rdul phran 'od gsal gyi ye shes lha sngags chos sku'i phyag rgyar sad: pho nya gsum gyi byin rlabs dang nus stobs thams cad rang la thim pas mkha' spyod chen po'i ye shes la dbang bsgyur: 'dul thabs bzhi'i phrin las thams cad lhun gyis grub par bsams la: oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye ma hā su kha sarba sid+dhi ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes 'bum phrag gcig bzla ba ni las sbyor te ye shes la dbang bar 'gyur ro: de ni gsung bzlas pa nyer bar bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor ro: thun mthar dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya brjod pas lhag chad bskang shing nus pa brtan pa byas nas mchod cing bstod/ bsnyen pa'i skabs lta bur thun thams cad du'am mi nus na dgong thun dang*/ rgyun lta bur srod kyi dus su gtor ma mdun bskyed bzlas pa'i mthar 'byung ba ltar phul mthar yig brgyas nongs pa bshags/ gtor mgron rten la bzhugs pa'am gshegs su gsol bar bya'o: des ni rnal 'byor pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi zhing tshe dang dpal 'byor gyi yon tan rgyas pa dang : las thams cad myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro: gnyis pa mdun bskyed la drug las dang po dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du chos kyi 'byung gnas yangs shing rgya che ba'i phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i lte bar sna tshogs pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du rang sems gnyug ma mi shigs pa'i thig le hrīḥyig dkar gsal yongs su gyur pa las skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar rab tu dkar zhing dwangs ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa:

zhi zhing 'dzum la cung zad khro bo'i nyams dang bcas rjes su chags pa'i gzi byin ches cher 'bar ba: rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal nag po ngur sgra sgrogs pas sa gsum g.yo ba: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba'i myu gu bzhi gtsigs pa: phyag g.yas pas 'khor los mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar bas gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog gcod cing : g.yon thod pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba thugs kar bsnams pas bde chen ye shes kyi rgyun 'bebs pa: gru mo g.yon du yab he ru ka sbas pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje'i kha ṭām̐ ga'i rnam par 'chang bas bde stong gnyis su med pa: dbu skra thor cog spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser 'khor los mtshan cing lhag ma sil bur grol bas sku sked yan chad khebs pa: nu 'bur mkhregs shing gsang ba'i pad+mo rgyas pa: thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can: rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang dar dpyangs kyis brgyan pa: zhabs g.yas pa skums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhugs pa'i snying ga'i dbus su rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems pa mtshon gang ba: de'i thugs kar nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor hrīḥdakar pos mtshan pa la sems gtad pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa skyes pa'i rkyen gyis de las 'od zer 'phros: lus kyi nang thams cad mun khung du sgron me btegs pa ltar gsal bar byas: de'i rkyen gyis skad cig gis snying ga'i nang skor gyi rtsa 'dab bzhi la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi: phyi skor brgyad la sgo mtshams ma brgyad: spyi bo la sogs pa'i rtsa mdud rnams su yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rnal 'byor ma rnams dang : gzhan yang rtsa khams thams cad dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba gdod nas lhun grub tu bzhugs pa rnams lam gyis gsal bar gyur/ lha rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po:

mgrin par āḥdamar po: thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po: lte bar hoḥser po rnams kyis mtshan pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i bdag nyid du bsams la: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3ham̐: zhes nga rgyal gzung : gnyis pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs pa ni/ mig gyen du blta zhing 'bar ba'i rgya dang bcas phaiṃ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo mkha' khyab tu sad par bsams la: oṃ: stong pa shin tu yod med las: ye shes sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra bhā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi: zhes pas spyan drang : badz+ra dzñā na sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gsum pa dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ slar yang phaiṃ zhes pas dbang lha nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs pa rnams kyis byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi'i sprin chen pos mngon par dbang bskur bas tha mal snang zhen gyi dri ma dag: bde ba mchog gi ye shes mngon du byas: chu lhag ma spyi bor brtan pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsams la: oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa ma hā su kha su ra s+t+waṃ a haṃ: bzhi pa mchod pa rgyas par bya ba la bdun las dang po phyi mchod ni/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ye shes las byung ba: rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan gzugs: lha rdzas me tog char chen 'bebs: dri zhim spos kyi sprin phung g.yo: snang gsal mar me'i 'od du 'bar: bsil zhing dri bsung ngad ldan chab: bza' bca' btung ba'i zhal zas mchog: snyan brjid rol mo'i dbyangs bcas kyis: chos dbyings rgyas par bkang byas nas: bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo mchod: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro dgyes par rol: las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra bhā rā hi sa pa ri wā ra hrī badz+ra ma hā rā ga puṣ+pe: dhū paṃ:

dī paṃ: gan+dhaṃ: nai bid+yaṃ: shap+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa nang mchod ni/ hūm̐: bde ba'i ye shes las byung ba: rnam pa kun ldan 'dod yon sprin: gzugs kyi nyams 'gyur rmad du byung : sgra chen rol mo mtha' yas ldan: dri zhim bdud rtsi char du 'bebs: ro bcud nus pa'i phung po brdal: 'jam 'khril reg bya'i longs spyod kyis: chos dbyings rgyas par bkang byas te: bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo mchod: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro dgyes par rol: las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra bhā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra shrī badz+ra ma hā rā ga rū pa: shab+da: gan+dhe: rā sa: spar+she kā ma gu ṇa sa ma ya hā+o: gsum pa gsang mchod ni/ hūm̐: zung 'jug ye shes las byung ba: thabs mchog he ru ka dpal gyi: rdo rje pad+mar mnyam sbyar bas: khams gsum gzung 'dzin dbyings su bsgral: dga' bzhi bde stong chen por sbyor: so so rang rig lhan cig skyes: bla na med pa'i 'don yon gyis: bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo mchod: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro dgyes par rol: las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra bhā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra shrī badz+ra ma hā rā ga bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: bzhi pa rmad du byung sman gtor rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: sha chen mchog gi bdud rtsi lnga: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i: rā sa yā na sman gyi bcud: dag mnyam rtogs pa'i longs spyod rdzas: dam tshig chen po'i 'dod yon gyis: bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo mchod: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro dgyes par rol: las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra bhā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a mṛ ta sid+dhi hoḥ hūm̐: rdo rje sgeg mo chags pa che: gīrti'i mkha' nas babs pa'i rgyun: khams gsum nyon mongs bsgral ba yi: dmar chen rak+ta'i rgya mtshor thim: gzi brjid chen po'i 'dod yon gyis:

bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo mchod: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro dgyes par rol: las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra bhā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra rak+ta pī pa hoḥ hūm̐: snod kyi 'jig rten khyon yangs par: bcud kyi sems can gtor mar sbyar: bza' bca' btung ba'i phung por spungs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i: longs spyod chen po'i 'dod yon gyis: bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo mchod: 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro dgyes par rol: las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra bhā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa bhūñdza hoḥ lnga pa sku bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ: bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo ni: zla ba ltar dkar rjes chags nyams: ye shes gzi byin cher 'bar ba: khams gsum dbang phyug ma la bstod: chags dang khro dang bzhad pa yis: 'dod khro gti mug nyon mongs sbyong : srid gsum rtog pa zil gnon pa'i: rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: sgra dbyangs rnam pa thams cad pa: zab mo'i rgyud dang sngags kyi tshul: sa gsum rmongs pa sad mdzad pa'i: tshangs pa'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: gcig pu ma yin mkha' dang mnyam: du mar mi gnas dbyings su 'khyil: mkhyen brtse'i rol pa bsam mi khyab: ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: lhun grub yon tan rgyan du rdzogs: 'du mi mdzad pa'i phrin las mnga': 'gro 'dul rdzu 'phrul mi zad gter: rgyal kun yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor du: rab 'byams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: spro zhing sdud pa'i cho 'phrul ston: khyab bdag chen mor phyag 'tshal bstod: gus pas mchod cing bstod pa'i mthus: gsang ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs: mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol: drug pa gsung sngags kyis mchod pa ni/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las: sngags phreng gnyis pa zhal nas byung : mdun bskyed lha mo'i zhal du zhugs:

sku yi dbyibs brgyud 'od zer gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bde bas mchod: dgyes pa chen po'i 'od snang dang : lhan cig sngags phreng lte ba nas: thon te rang gi lte bar zhugs: bar ma chad par 'khor ba las: 'od dang 'od zer bsam yas 'phros: gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mchod: khams gsum tha mal snang zhen sbyangs: lha sngags ye shes 'khor lor sad: dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub par bsam: oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ya gu h+ya dzñā na bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā: zhes ci nus su bzla'o: bdun pa thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis mchod pa ni/ aḥ 'khor 'das kun khyab byang chub sems: lha dang bdag nyid dbyer med pa: ma bcos gnyug ma khyab gdal ngang : mi g.yo mi smra bsam brjod 'das: sarba dzñā na dhā tu a a: zhes dgongs pa bskyang : dbyangs gsal yig brgya brjod pas lhag chad bskang shing nus pa brtan par byas nas mchod cing bstod/ dbang bskur dgos skabs dbang chog nang gi tshe sgrub dang sman sgrub la 'jug /lnga pa gtor ma phul ba ni/ thun mthar thod pa la sogs pa'i snod du ba lang gi sha dang chang gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma la bdud rtsis bran/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas gtor ma'i dngos 'dzin mi dmigs te stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las rlung dang : me dang : thod pa'i sgyed pu la brten pa'i rang byung bde skyong gi snod yangs shing rgya che bar bcud sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ge 'bru bcus mtshan pa: rlung me'i sbyor bas thod pa dros: rdzas yi ge dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil: slar yang steng gi nam mkhar nyi ma la gnas pa'i kha ṭ+wām̐ ga 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa'i 'od kyis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang : dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi bkug: kha ṭ+wām̐ yi ge dang bcas pa la thim: de nyid gdan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas bcud la thim pas dam tshig dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i bdud rtsi 'dod yon rnam pa thams cad pa'i sprin du 'phro bar

bsams la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī: zhes lan gsum gyis brlab: oṃ badz+ra bhā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi: badz+ra dzñā na sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gtor mgron spyan drangs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar mkha' khyab tu bzhugs par bsams la: rdo rje thal mo se gol gyi sgra dang bcas: oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī pa ri wā ra sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+wam̐: i daṃ ba liṃ bhūñdza ho: a mri ta pī pa ho: pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa ho: ma ma sarba karma sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu: ha ha hi hi hai hai ho ho phaṭa swā hā: zhes lan bdun gyis phul la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga puṣ+paṃ: dhū paṃ: dī paṃ: gan+dhaṃ: nai bid+yaṃ: shap+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa sa ma ya ho: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: rak+ta bi pa ho: i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa bhūñdza ho: oṃḥ bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo ni: zla ba ltar dkar rjes chags nyams: ye shes gzi byin cher 'bar ba: khams gsum dbang phyug ma la bstod: bcom ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kun: mchod dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi: phyi nang bar gcod zhi ba dang : mi mthun phyogs kun srung mdzad gsol: tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes spel: log par lta ba dbang du sdus: bdud dang dgra bgegs cham la phob: 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa sogs: dngos grub ji ltar 'dod pa yi: las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: ces mchod bstod phrin las bcol/ de nas bka' gter srung ma'i gtor chog rgyas bsdus gang 'grub bya/ drug pa nyams chags bshags skong la bshags pa dang skong ba'i rim pa gnyis las dang po la lnga las thog mar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis: gnas yul gsang ba mchog gi zhing : mchod gtor ye shes rol pa'i rgyan: nam mkha' mdzod kyi sprin du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐:

dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis spel/ gnyis pa spyan drangs pa ni/ rang gi thugs srog sa bon las: 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam par 'phros: rtsa gsum chos srung rab 'byams kun: mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi kā sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+wam̐: e h+ye hi: badz+ra sa ma ya dza: gsum pa lus kyi nyams chags bskang phyir phyag 'tshal ba ni/ ho: dgongs klong dbyer med brda yis mtshon: snyan rgyud bdud rtsis skal ldan skyong : byin rlabs thugs rje'i bdag nyid che: rtsa brgyud bla ma la phyag 'tshal: chos sku'i ngang las longs spyod rdzogs: sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul cir yang ston: dngos grub rnam gnyis char bzhin 'bebs: yi dam zhi khro la phyag 'tshal: lhan skyes ngang las ma g.yos bzhin: zhing sngags ḍā ka'i sprin phung 'phro: mchog thun phrin las glog ltar 'khyugs: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal: rig 'dzin bla ma'i bka' bzhin du: rnal 'byor sgrub mchog bu bzhin skyong : legs nyes stangs 'dzin bar chad sel: chos srung gter bdag la phyag 'tshal: phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la: sgo gsum gus pas dad phyag 'tshal: nyams chags sdig sgrib zhi ba dang : ye shes rgyas par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ gu ru sarba ta tha ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta pra ṇa mye na ben+da naṃ ka ro mi:

bzhi pa ngag gi nyam chags skong phyir rdor sems sgom bzlas bya ba ni/ āḥ bdag gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng : bla ma rdor sems he ru ka: yab yum thugs ka'i sngags phreng dang : sku las byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun: sbyor mtshams nas byung tshangs bug zhugs: lus gang sdig sgrib nyes ltung rgyu: 'bras bu nad gdon sdug bsngal kun: dag cing dri ma med par bsam: stobs bzhi'i gnad dang ldan pas yi ge brgya pa dzab tu bzla/ lnga pa gdung bas smre bshags bya ba ni/ oṃ: bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems: bdag la re sa khyed las med: thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs mdzod la: nyams chags sdig ltung sbyang mdzad gsol: bdag cag nyon mongs gzhan dbang dang : mi shes bag med ma gus pas: rang bzhin kha na ma tho dang : bcas pa'i bslab las 'gal ba kun: dag cing tshangs par stsal du gsol: khyad par rdo rje theg pa yi: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs mchog dang : yan lag dam tshig nyi shu lnga: med phyal gcig pu lhun grub sogs: rang bzhin lta ba'i dam tshig las: nyams 'gal ral bar gyur pa kun: snying nas 'gyod pas mthol bshags na: sgrib med tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: nyid dang dbyer med byin rlobs shig: snying nas gdung bas gsol btab pas: bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yis: sdig ltung dag pa'i gnang ba stsal: dgyes pas 'od zhu rang la thim: yid kyi nyams chags bskang ba'i phyir: rang yang kun gzhi ma bcos pa'i: ngang la yid ni 'dzin pa bral: rnam dag spros bral chos kyi sku: chos kyi sku la gnyis su med: ye bsrung thig le nyag gcig ngang : spang blang las 'das phyal ba che: rang byung rang shar lhun gyis grub: nyams chags rtog sgrib dbyings su grol: ma bcos rdzogs pa chen po'o: a a aḥ zhes spro bsdu bral bar mnyam par bzhag /gnyis pa skong gi cho ga la rnam pa gsum las dang po thun mong nyer spyod rdzas kyis bskang ba ni/ oṃ: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul:

rab 'byams zhing gi mchod pa'i sprin: rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: dgyes bzhes dam skongs dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta de ba ḍā ki nī sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ pād+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: gnyis pa khyad par sman rag gtor mas bskang ba ni/ oṃ: rtsa gsum 'khor lo'i bhan+dha ru: ye shes byang sems bdud rtsi bskyil: bde ba chen po'i dam tshig 'dis: rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : nyams chags sdig ltung dbyings su zhi: gzung 'dzin rtog sgrib rang sar grol: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha hi: āḥ 'khor lo lnga yi bhañdza ru: gnyis snang bsgral ba'i rak+tas bskang : gzi brjid chen po'i dam tshig 'dis: rtsa brgyud bla ma sogs= ma hā rak+ta khā hi: hūm̐: phung khams skye mched gtor gzhong du: bde chen longs spyod gtor ma bshams: 'dod yon rgyan gyi dam tshig 'dis: rtsa brgyud bla ma sogs= ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hī: bzhi pa dbang bzhi'i dam tshig nyams chags skong ba'i slad du mchog gi bskang ba ni/ mar me thogs te dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing*/ oṃ: snang ba snod kyi kong bu ru: srid pa bcud kyi mar khus gtams: lus gnas rtsa yi sdong bu btsugs: snang stong zung 'jug mar me sbar: dag pa rab 'byams mchod sprin 'dis: kun bzang rdo rje phag mo yum: gnas gsum dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma: thugs rje sprul sku'i bdag nyid can: mkha' khyab 'dus pa'i thugs dam bskang : spyi dang khyad par lhag pa sogs: rdo rje theg pa'i 'dul ba dang : khyad par bum pa'i dbang gi lam: mnyam gzhag bskyed rim ma gsal zhing : rjes thob tha mal snang bar zhen: bza' ba sha lnga bdud rtsi dang : bcang ba'i rdo rje dril bu spangs: bsrung bya rtsa ba yan lag gi: dam tshig nyams chags gyur pa kun: snying nas 'gyod pas mthol bshags shing :

phyin chad mi bgyid dam bca' na: dag cing tshangs par dbugs phyung nas: sku yi rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra kā ya dī pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: āḥ dbu ma rtsa yi kong bu ru: srog rtsol rlung gi mar khus gtams: kha sbyor nā da'i sdong bu btsugs: gsal stong zung 'jug mar me sbar: dbang sgyur chen po'i mchod sprin 'dis: kun bzang rdo rje phag mo yum: gnas gsum dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma: rang bzhin longs sku'i bdag nyid can: mkha' khyab 'dus pa'i thugs dam bskang : spyi dang khyad par lhag pa sogs: rdo rje theg pa'i 'dul ba dang : khyad par gsang ba'i dbang gi lam: mnyam gzhag rtsa rlung ma bsgoms shing : rjes thob de nyid lam ma longs: bza' ba stong gsal bdud rtsi spangs: bcang ba srog rtsol rang gar shor: bsrung bya kha sbyor dang bral ba'i: dam tshig nyams chags gyur pa kun: snying nas 'gyod pas mthol bshags shing : phyin chad mi bgyid dam bca' na: dag cing tshangs par dbugs phyung nas: gsung gi rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra wā ka dī pe pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: 'khor lo bzhi yi kong bu ru: thig le bzhi yi mar khus gtams: dga' ba bzhi yi sdong bu btsugs: stong pa bzhi yi mar me sbar: lhan skyes bde ba'i mchod sprin 'dis: kun bzang rdo rje phag mo yum: gnas gsum dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma: ngo bo chos sku'i bdag nyid can: mkha' khyab 'dus pa'i thugs dam bskang : spyi dang khyad par lhag pa sogs: rdo rje theg pa'i 'dul ba dang : khyad par gsum pa'i dbang gi lam: mnyam gzhag bde stong ma bsgoms shing : rjes spyod lhan skyes nyams dang bral: bza' ba bde ba'i bdud rtsi dang : bcang bya dngos yid phyag rgya spangs: bsrung bya thig le 'pho ba yi: dam tshig nyams chags gyur pa kun: snying nas 'gyod pas mthol bshags shing : phyin chad mi bgyid dam bca' na: dag cing tshangs par dbugs phyung nas: thugs kyi rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol:

oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta dī pa pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: ho: gzung 'dzin yul gyi kong bu ru: yul can ye shes mar khus gtams: snang sems zung 'jug sdong bu btsugs: blo 'das rang byung mar me sbar: 'od gsal chen po'i mchod sprin 'dis: kun bzang rdo rje phag mo yum: gnas gsum dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma: dbyer med bde chen bdag nyid can: mkha' khyab 'dus pa'i thugs dam bskang : spyi dang khyad par lhag pa sogs: rdo rje theg pa'i 'dul ba dang : khyad par bzhi ba'i dbang gi lam: mnyam gzhag gnas lugs ma bsgoms shing : rjes thob tha mal 'khrul par shor: bza' ba stong nyid bdud rtsi dang : bcang bya rtse gcig ting 'dzin g.yel: bsrung bya gzung 'dzin rtogs pas g.yengs: dam tshig nyams chags gyur pa kun: snying nas 'gyod pas mthol bshags shing : phyin chad mi bgyid dam bca' na: dag cing tshangs par dbugs phyung nas: ye shes rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra dzñā na dī pi pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: zhes brjod cing nges shes bskyed la gdung shugs drag pos bshags pas dbang bzhi'i sdom pa dang dam tshig gi nyes ltung thams cad sor chud par 'gyur ro: bzhi pa smon lam gdab pa ni/ ho: gsang mchog rdo rje btsun mo'i dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje slob dpon sgrub pa'i mched lcam gyis: bsnyen sgrub skong ba'i cho gar brtson pa'i mthus: rgyud dag dngos grub rnam gnyis rgyas par shog: bum dbang dam tshig nyams chags sor chud cing : snang stong zung 'jug ye shes gong du 'phel: thun mong las kyi tshogs kun 'grub pa dang : kun tu 'od kyi sa la dbyugs phyung zhig: gsang ba'i dbang gi dam tshig nyams chags byang : gsal stong zung 'jug ye shes gong du 'phel: rlung sems lha sku'i phyag rgya 'grub pa dang : pad+ma can gyi sa la phyin par shog: gsum pa'i dbang gi dam tshig nyams chags dag: bde stong zung 'jug ye shes gong du 'phel: 'od gsal ngang las lhan skyes sgyu ma'i sku:

'khor lo'i tshogs chen bde bas dbugs phyung zhig: don gyi dbang gi dam tshig nyams chags grol: rig stong zung 'jug ye shes gong du 'phel: slob pa min pa'i go 'phang la brten nas: ye shes bla ma'i sa la lhun rdzogs shog: tshe 'dir 'bras bu mngon du ma gyur na: 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku'i dbyings su thim: bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: skye srid sprul pas 'gro don lhun grub shog: rlung sems 'khrul snang mun pa 'char srid tshe: ye shes mar me'i snang bas shul mtshon te: bde stong dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis: mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du dbugs phyung zhig: mdor na 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar: bka' drin can gyi rdo rje slob dpon dang : nam yang mi 'bral byin gyis brlabs pa las: phyams gcig gdod ma'i sa la grol bar shog: ces 'dun pa rtse gcig pas gdab/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la drug las thog mar tshogs kyi 'khor lo ni/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams la bsang chus bran/ hūm̐: zhes brjod pas tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin mi dmigs te stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las rlung dang : me dang : thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la brten pa'i rang byung bde skyong gi snod yangs shing rgya che bar bcud sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ge 'bru bcus mtshan pa: rlung me'i sbyor bas thod pa dros: rdzas yi ge dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil: slar yang steng gi nam mkhar nyi ma la gnas pa'i kha ṭ+wām̐ ga 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa'i 'od kyis rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang : dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi bkug: kha ṭ+wām̐ yi ge dang bcas pa la thim: de nyid gdan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas bcud la thim pas dam tshig dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i bdud rtsi 'dod yon rnam pa thams cad pa'i sprin du 'phro bar bsams la:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī: zhes lan gsum gyis brlab/ tshogs phud cha gsum du spros la/ hūm̐: chos sku kun bzang rdo rje 'chang : longs sku dpal ldan he ru ka: yi dam zhi khro'i sprin phung 'phro: sprul sku rdo rje phag mo yum: rigs bzhi'i snying po'i rnal 'byor ma: las kyi dbang chen mkha' 'gro'i gtso: rang byung sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes: sprul pa'i mtshan mchog brgyad la sogs: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs: mkha' khyab rnam 'phrul sprin ltar gtibs: thugs rje thugs dam rtsal skyed la: rnal 'byor longs spyod chen po yi: tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs su gsol: bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan pa'i: tshogs kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang : thog med dus nas da lta'i bar: sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba yi: dam tshig nyams chags nyes pa dang : sdig ltung thams cad mthol zhing bshags: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: nad gdod sdig sgrib zhi bar mdzod: tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes spel: rlung sems snang ba dbang du sdus: dngos grub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: gnas nyul dhā ki'i sun ma dang : byad phur rbod gtong 'jigs brgyad zlog: dgra bgegs 'byung po rdul du rlog: ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa yi: rgyu rkyen 'bras bu dbyings su sbyongs: snod bcud dge ba'i legs tshogs skyed: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍa la badz+ra bhā rā hī sarba dhā ki ni ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: hūm̐: gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa: de bzhin nye gnas dri ma med: zhing ni 'od rab byed pa'i sa: nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro ba: tshan+dhā+o mngon du gyur pa ste: nye ba'i tshan+dho sbyang dka' ba: 'du ba ring du song ba ste: nye ba'i 'du ba mi g.yo ba: dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros te: nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin:

he ru ka dpal dgyes pa'i yul: gnas yul dur khrod rab 'byams na: bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma: mkha' 'gro dang ni mkha' 'gro ma: khro chags sgeg pa'i tshul 'chang ba'i: mkha' khyab rnam 'phrul sprin ltar gtibs: thugs rje thugs dam rtsal skyed la: rnal 'byor longs spyod chen po yi: tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs su gsol: bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan pa'i: tshogs kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang : thog med dus nas da lta'i bar: sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba yi: dam tshig nyams chags nyes pa dang : sdig ltung thams cad mthol zhing bshags: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: nad gdod sdig sgrib zhi bar mdzod: tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes spel: rlung sems snang ba dbang du sdus: dngos grub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: gnas nyul dhā ki'i sun ma dang : byad phur rbod gtong 'jigs brgyad zlog: dgra bgegs 'byung po rdul du rlog: ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa yi: rgyu rkyen 'bras bu dbyings su sbyongs: snod bcud dge ba'i legs tshogs skyed: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ shrī sarba wī ra yo gi nī ḍā ki ḍā ki ni ma hā su kha ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: hūm̐: chos nyid zhi las ma g.yos kyang : bstan pa srung phyir 'bar ba'i rtsal: dpal ldan mgon po nag po che: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las sras: lha mo nag mo re ma tī: rje khol bran dang yang g.yog sogs: rgyud gsum dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kun: mkha' khyab rnam 'phrul sprin ltar gtibs: thugs rje thugs dam rtsal skyed la: rnal 'byor longs spyod chen po yi: tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs su gsol: bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: zag med bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan pa'i: tshogs kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang : thog med dus nas da lta'i bar:

sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba yi: dam tshig nyams chags nyes pa dang : sdig ltung thams cad mthol zhing bshags: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: nad gdod sdig sgrib zhi bar mdzod: tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes spel: rlung sems snang ba dbang du sdus: dngos grub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: gnas nyul dhā ki'i sun ma dang : byad phur rbod gtong 'jigs brgyad zlog: dgra bgegs 'byung po rdul du rlog: ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa yi: rgyu rkyen 'bras bu dbyings su sbyongs: snod bcud dge ba'i legs tshogs skyed: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ma hā kā lī de wī sarba dharma pā la ma hā su kha ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: zhes phul zhing yi ge brgya pas nyams chags bshags sbyang bya ba dang bcas phyi dkyil rnams 'dod yon gyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags/ dbang bskur sogs dgos na skabs 'dir bya/

brda dang brda yi 'bul len bcas nang rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i phyir bza' btung rnams la tshim par longs spyod/ gsang ba snyoms 'jug gi bde ba spel zhing de kho na nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par gzhag /lhag ma rnams gsog 'jog med par bsdus la/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi'i kha khru dbab/ pañtsa a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa brlab: phaiṃ: rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor du: phyi 'khor skyong ba'i bka' nyan ni: dbang phyug ging dang lang ka'i tshogs: mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro pho nya'i sde: ma lus lus pa med pa kun: he ru ka dpal spyan snga ru: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa yi: 'khor srungs rkyen zlog bar chad sol: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod sogs: 'dod pa'i las kun 'grub par mdzod: oṃ sarba kiṅka ra uts+tshiṣ+ta ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba karma ku ru ho: zhes phyi rol du bskyal: bkra shis kyi glu blangs shing smon lam gdab pa ni: oṃ: bkra shis gang zhig he ru ka dpal dgyes pa'i yum: rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod pa'i mthus: bdag gzhan 'gro kun dam tshig nyams chags nyes ltung zhi: bsod nams tshogs rdzogs ye shes 'bras bu mngon 'gyur shog: ces brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya'o: gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni mchod pa kha gsos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ shrī badz+ra rā ga puṣ+paṃ: dhū paṃ: dī paṃ: gan+dhaṃ: nai bid+yaṃ: shap+da pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐: pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa sa ma ya ho: bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: rak+ta bi pa ho: i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa bhūñdza ho: bstod pa ni/ oṃ: bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo ni: zla ba ltar dkar rjes chags nyams: ye shes gzi byin cher 'bar ba: khams gsum dbang phyug ma la bstod: gnyis pa dngos grub kyi slad du dkyil 'khor gyi mdun thod pa mtshan ldan bdud rtsis gang ba bshams la:

bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: mdun bskyed kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs rgyud bskul: de'i thugs ka dang sku'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par char bzhin du babs te dam tshig gi rdzas la thim par bsam: oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye ma hā su kha dzñā na hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dzñā na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes ci rigs bzlas pas bskul te thod pa spyi bor bkod la/ oṃ: bde mchog bde spyod nam mkha'i dbyings: mkha' dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo yum: rab 'byams dhā ki'i tshogs dang bcas: bsnyen sgrub rtse gcig brtson lags na: thugs rje thugs dam rtsal skyed la: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: gsang ba gsum gyi byin rlabs mchog: rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la stsol: rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes dang : dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol: oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye ma hā su kha dzñā na hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wā ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: dzñā na sid+dhi hrī: zhes brjod cing thod pa gnas bzhir reg la bdud rtsi myang : yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyis mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa rten la bstim: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ gsum pa rtag mtha' bsal ba ni/ hrī: rang gi thugs srog sa bon las: 'od 'phros dag pa'i snod dang bcud: 'od zhu hrīḥl gnyis med thim: de yang mi dmigs ngang du bzhag: a a a: bzhi pa chad mtha' bsal ba ni/ slar yang chu las rlabs bzhin du: rang lus badz+ra wā rā hī: snang ba lha dang grags pa sngags: dran rtog 'od gsal ngang nas spyod: lnga pa bsngo smon ni/ bdag gis bsnyen cing bsgrubs la sogs: dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs mthus: 'gro kun rdo rje btsun mo dang :

dbyer med mngon par byang chub shog: drug pa bkra shis ni/ oṃ: kun tu bzang mo dbyings kyi yum: chos kyi sku yi bkra shis shog: rdo rje btsun mo dgyes pa che: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bkra shis shog: gnas yul dur khrod mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: sprul pa'i sku yi bkra shis shog: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kyis: rtag tu dge ba'i bkra shis shog: ces brjod me tog gi char dbab pas dge legs su bya'o/ /gter gzhung las/ de ltar brtson pas dam tshig nyams chags kyi nyes ltung zhi: tshe dang ye shes dang 'byor pa brgyas: bde ba chen po'i rtogs pa 'phel: snang sems dbang du 'du: gnas gsum gyi pho nya'i 'du ba thob cing mchog gi dngos grub myur du 'grub: sgrub pa chen po'i gzhi things par 'gyur ro: zhes gsungs pa la yid ches bskyed de brtson pa lhur len pa ni don dang ldan pa lags so/ /ces pa'ang rgyal kun ye shes kyi phung po bdag cag gi 'dren par chas pa 7'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che thub bstan chos kyi rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas/ mkhyen brtse'i bka' babs kyi smin grol rdzogs par stsal ba'i skal bzang mngon du gyur pa'i mjug thogs su/pad+ma mthong grol gyi cod paṇa tshangs gnas kyi rgyan du bkod de zab chos 'di dag gi bdag por mnga' gsol ba thob pa phun tshogs rnam rgyal pas/ 2008 lor bka' babs skor bskyar bsgrig skabs bod zla gsum pa'i tshes gnyis la gter gzhung las bklag chog tu bsdebs pa 'dis kyang rgyal bstan dar shing skye rgu bde ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ //
